enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Remain still. Turn body to left side. Adjust pillow under head. Turn body to right side. Pull blanket up to chin. Extend legs. Remain still. Turn body to back. Keep eyes closed. Breathe slowly.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Swing legs over side of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour oil into pan. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Open microwave. Put bread in microwave. Close microwave. Press start button. Eat breakfast.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed in work clothes and packing bag for the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out work shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Put on pants. Zip pants. Open drawer. Take out stethoscope. Put stethoscope around neck. Open bag. Put wallet in bag. Put phone in bag. Put keys in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Stand up. Pull cord. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Push door open. Walk to locker room. Open locker. Change into scrubs. Close locker. Walk to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending to patients and clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to nurse station. Pick up clipboard. Review patient charts. Walk to patient room 1. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Measure temperature. Measure pulse. Record data on chart. Walk to patient room 2. Check IV drip. Adjust flow rate. Walk to supply room. Pick up bandages. Walk to patient room 3. Change dressing. Walk to nurse station.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select sandwich. Select fruit. Select drink. Pay at cashier. Walk to table. Sit down. Unwrap sandwich. Eat sandwich. Drink beverage. Eat fruit. Wipe mouth with napkin. Pick up tray. Walk to trash bin. Throw away trash. Place tray on conveyor. Walk to restroom. Wash hands. Walk back to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical duties and patient care at the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room 5. Check patient monitor. Adjust oxygen level. Walk to nurse station. Update patient records. Walk to patient room 6. Assist patient with walking. Walk to medication room. Prepare injection. Walk to patient room 7. Administer injection. Walk to nurse station. Answer call light. Walk to patient room 8. Help patient to bathroom. Walk to supply room. Restock gloves. Walk to nurse station. Consult with colleague. Walk to patient room 9. Change bed linens.

Walk to locker room. Open locker. Change out of scrubs. Put on street clothes. Close locker. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Stand up. Pull cord. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to home. Open door. Walk inside. Close door.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and chicken. Close refrigerator. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour oil into pan. Add chicken. Stir chicken. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Pick up sponge. Apply dish soap. Pick up plate. Scrub plate. Rinse plate. Place plate in dish rack. Pick up cup. Scrub cup. Rinse cup. Place cup in dish rack. Pick up fork. Scrub fork. Rinse fork. Place fork in dish rack. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe counter. Wipe stove.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower after the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Open shower curtain. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Wet body. Pick up soap. Rub soap on body. Rinse body. Pick up shampoo. Apply shampoo to hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote control. Press power button. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Pick up glass. Drink water. Put glass down. Adjust cushion. Lean back. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Turn up volume. Watch TV. Stand up.

Walk to bedroom. Lie on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media app. Scroll through feed. Tap on video. Watch video. Type comment. Send comment. Open messaging app. Send message to friend. Receive reply. Read reply. Type reply. Send reply. Lock phone. Put phone on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Lie down.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing for bed, turning off lamp and adjusting room temperature
enriched_activities.desc: Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to thermostat. Press button. Adjust temperature down. Walk to window. Open window slightly. Walk to bed. Pull blanket back. Fluff pillow. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Adjust pillow. Turn off lamp. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Remain still.

Lie on bed. Close eyes. Remain still. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Extend legs. Remain still. Turn to back. Keep eyes closed. Breathe slowly. Continue sleeping.
